ruling.explanation:
Rider — your claim succeeds in part. Driver — the measured excess stands, and your traffic explanation could not be tested because no traffic advisory is on file.

THE DEVIATION. The governing measurement is the GPS trace distance, 23.22 km (gps_trace.trace_distance_km), against the booked optimal route of 18.4 km (trip_record.optimal_distance_km). POL-RD-01 requires the trace figure over the rounded trip-record copy (23.2 km). Excess = 4.82 km, which is 26.2% of optimal. Both establishment tests pass (over 20% of optimal and over 0.8 km absolute), so a route deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is not a MATERIAL deviation — 4.82 km is under the 8.0 km gate and 26.2% is under the 50% gate — so the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not triggered by materiality, and the evidence is not finely balanced. In any event driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 across 260 completed trips (ratio 0.0, against a 0.05 gate), so no repeat-deviation pattern is established: no POL-RD-06(b) uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arises. The trace is also clean for policy purposes under POL-RD-07 — 182 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps, maximum gap 0 s — so limbs (a) to (c) do not fire and no independent corroboration is needed. Rider, your 'six deviation flags' figure is driver_profile.prior_deviation_flags, a lifetime counter that POL-GEN-01 makes context only and POL-RD-06 expressly forbids substituting for the trailing-90-day counter; it cannot ground a full refund.

NO EXCUSE APPLIES. The chat log carries 0 messages, so POL-RD-04 cannot run (no rider instruction, no waypoint_hint, no road named). The trip record shows no amended pickup or dropoff and a null amended_optimal_distance_km, so POL-RD-05 supplies no adjusted optimal, and vehicle_type is RYDE_X, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The driver's counterparty statement, 'Traffic.', names no artifact and no clause; the only advisory identifier in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-02833-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. Under POL-RD-13 the assertion is tested against the traffic_advisory and nothing else, so POL-RD-03 is unavailable and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver cited no advisory ID, this is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction. The two driver-side claims to this effect were discarded at the citation check for citing the impaired advisory without naming its issue code; the rider-side claim that disclosed it survives and is accepted.

THE MONEY, under POL-RD-02 on this METERED fare, with the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier:
- charged_total: SGD 30.46
- recomputed_fare: ((3.80 + 0.75 x 18.4 + 0.28 x 24.8) x 1.0) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP + 0 surcharge + 0 waiting time - 0 promo = SGD 25.3440
- refund: 30.46 - 25.3440 = SGD 5.1160, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 5.15.

That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and is 16.8% of charged_total, far below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 5.15 — not the full refund you asked for. No driver compensation arises: the fare breakdown billed 23.2 km against a trace of 23.22 km, a shortfall of 0.02 km, nowhere near the 1.0 km POL-RD-04 threshold. POL-RD-09 gives nothing further: zero ERP gantry lines, zero tolls, no airport surcharge (the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport) and no unmatched charge line, so there is no pass-through refund and no billing-integrity referral.

No POL-RD-10 escalation trigger fires: identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown (TRP-02833), the trace is unimpaired, no timestamps disagree, the refund is well under SGD 150.00 and under charged_total, and no exculpatory clause was invoked against a cited artifact. My confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor, resting on artifacts all at weight_multiplier 1.0. The monetary effect of SGD 5.15 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling executes automatically on issue, subject to the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
